lines.text: What if your whole wallet… fit on a card?
This is Noir. Tap into trust.
Any NFC card or sticker. Hold it to your phone — and it's registered on Stellar.
Every card pays through its own on-chain agent — with its own balance.
Top it up with exactly what it should spend. Nothing more.
Lost it? Revoke it in one tap — and every last XLM sweeps back to you.
And it's a full Stellar wallet. Send, receive, track — locked behind your keys.
Built on Soroban smart contracts. Open source. Live on Stellar Testnet.
